title: SSV Silver Gull — Ship Combat
description: Ship-combat systems for the SSV Silver Gull campaign. Full-screen Ship Overview (press S) with a crew-centric multiplayer turn/action tracker and per-station action consoles for all 15 stations. Shields/Comms is fully built (Allocate Shields, Jam/Hail rolls, violet-arc Micro-Adjust); the Captain's Grant Actions gives a crew a purple-star extra action. A GM-only ⚙ GM Actions panel changes shields directly (no action cost) and announces to chat. Ship Inventory is a game-style grid (item pictures, search, ship/you tabs, hover detail popup) linked to the dnd5e ship actor: move items crew↔ship, FUEL/POWER gauges, use fuel items, convert fuel→power, and GMs can add any item via a searchable browser over all world items + item compendiums (or drag-drop).
